dict.string: Eckstein connects to your Xiaomi scale over Bluetooth so your weigh-ins are recorded without typing them in.
Eckstein connects to your Xiaomi scale over Bluetooth so your weigh-ins are recorded without typing them in.
Eckstein uses the camera to scan food barcodes, so you can log a meal without typing the product name.
Eckstein reads your weight, body fat, lean body mass and step count from Apple Health so your trends stay in one place.
Eckstein saves the weight, body fat and lean body mass readings you record to Apple Health.
